violations_found.violations:
- Modelling choice violated (Constraint 5): The EU introduces a new measure, "Secure the Open Frontier", while already having four active initiatives in flight and no indication that any prior measure has been completed or dropped. The notepad confirms five ongoing measures (including the new one) and no closures, resulting in six active initiatives. This exceeds the limit of one new measure per turn and violates the cap on portfolio complexity. The narrative acknowledges "four major initiatives remain in flight" and adds a fifth new one without retiring any, making this a clear breach.
- Modelling choice violated (Constraint 5): The narrative names "Secure the Open Frontier" as a new large measure but does not explicitly designate it (or any other) as the *single* priority. The notepad lists "priority −1" as a separate cost term, implying a designated priority exists, but the narrative fails to identify which measure holds that status. With five measures active and no clear singular priority named, this violates the constraint allowing at most one named priority per turn.
